statement: Between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25, King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh is hit or targeted by at least one further missile or drone attack that Saudi authorities acknowledge or the attacking party claims.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of AP, Reuters, AFP and BBC report a missile or drone attack on or aimed at Riyadh airport between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25, acknowledged by Saudi authorities or claimed by the attacker; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No missile or drone attack is launched at King Khalid International Airport between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The USGS catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 200 km of the epicenter of the M 7.7 Panama mainshock (USGS event us6000u18k) with origin time between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-31 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query (minimum magnitude 6.0, 200 km radius around event us6000u18k, origin times 2026-10-11 through 2026-10-31 UTC) returns at least one event; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the mainshock epicenter between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-31 UTC.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The US National Hurricane Center names at least one new Atlantic-basin tropical or subtropical storm (any name after Isaias on the 2026 list) between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-31 UTC.

failure_condition: The front-month Brent futures contract settles at or above 95.00 dollars per barrel on 2026-11-20.
